title: mentha × verticillata f. ballotifolia
intro: Mentha × verticillata f. ballotifolia, commonly known as American pennyroyal, is a species of mint native to North America, characterized by its compact growth and small, rounded leaves. The plant is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, relieve nausea and headaches, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of American pennyroyal include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of American pennyroyal include menthone, limonene, and other volatile compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
